name: tls-version-1-2-only
stimulus: Independent peer offers or selects only TLS 1.2.

name: tls-cipher-suite-other
stimulus: Independent peer offers or selects only TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 / TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256.

name: tls-signature-scheme-other
stimulus: Independent peer offers only rsa_pss_rsae_sha256 / ecdsa_secp384r1_sha384, or signs CertificateVerify with another scheme.

name: tls-certificate-vectors
stimulus: Each golden certificate vector of the end's role is presented in a live handshake; the decision equals the vector and every rejection aborts the handshake.

name: tls-negative-decision-aborts-handshake
stimulus: Pin mismatch presented live; the handshake must abort inside certificate verification (no optional-verify path, no application data).

name: tls-key-update-received
stimulus: After readiness the independent peer sends KeyUpdate.

name: tls-record-overflow
stimulus: Independent peer sends a TLS record whose plaintext is 4353 bytes.

name: tls-record-sender-cap
stimulus: Send a 4098-byte frame; every outgoing record plaintext is at most 4352 bytes.

name: tls-group-other-no-hrr
stimulus: ClientHello offers only x25519 groups and key shares; the board must not send HelloRetryRequest.

name: tls-key-share-missing
stimulus: ClientHello lists secp256r1 but carries no key share.

name: tls-alpn-absent
stimulus: ClientHello carries no ALPN extension.

name: tls-alpn-other
stimulus: ClientHello offers only pdsh-ble-task/2.

name: tls-client-certificate-empty
stimulus: Client answers CertificateRequest with an empty Certificate.

name: tls-psk-offered
stimulus: ClientHello carries psk_key_exchange_modes and pre_shared_key; the board never selects a PSK.

name: tls-early-data-offered
stimulus: ClientHello carries early_data and sends 0-RTT data; the board accepts none of it.

name: tls-no-ticket-sent
stimulus: Complete a handshake and session; the board sends no NewSessionTicket.

name: tls-no-half-rtt-data
stimulus: Board sends no application data before it has verified client Certificate, CertificateVerify and Finished.

name: tls-client-flight-fits-input-buffer
stimulus: Client Certificate (1024-byte DER) plus CertificateVerify completes against the configured input buffer.

name: tls-alpn-not-selected
stimulus: Server completes the handshake without selecting ALPN.

name: tls-server-group-other
stimulus: Server selects a group other than secp256r1.

name: tls-client-hello-profile
stimulus: Capture the phone ClientHello: only the §6.1 extensions, no PSK, early_data, post_handshake_auth, server_name, max_fragment_length or record_size_limit.

name: tls-server-sends-ticket
stimulus: Server sends NewSessionTicket after the handshake; the phone never stores or uses it.

name: tls-half-rtt-data-before-ready
stimulus: Server sends an application frame immediately after its Finished, before ready_req.

name: coc-credit-vectors
stimulus: Every ble-secure-coc-cases.jsonl vector through the real receive path with a fake L2CAP below it.

name: coc-send-beyond-credits
stimulus: Peer sends one K-frame more than the credits it holds.

name: coc-zero-length-sdu
stimulus: Peer sends a first K-frame with SDU length 0.

name: coc-sdu-over-mtu
stimulus: Peer sends an SDU length above the board MTU.

name: coc-kframe-over-mps
stimulus: Peer sends a K-frame above the board MPS.

name: coc-garbage-instead-of-client-hello
stimulus: Peer sends 4 KiB of random bytes as the first TLS bytes.

name: coc-disconnect-during-queued-send
stimulus: Board send queued with BLE_HS_ESTALLED, then the LE link drops; no byte is sent twice and no buffer leaks.

name: coc-second-concurrent-coc
stimulus: Peer opens a second CoC on the PSM while one is open.

name: coc-handshake-stall
stimulus: Peer opens the CoC and sends nothing (and, separately, half a ClientHello).

name: coc-client-hello-flood-with-reconnect
stimulus: Peer repeats open CoC, ClientHello, disconnect for 10 minutes; heap and task counts stay bounded.

name: coc-enrolled-phone-served-after-attacks
stimulus: After the CoC attack rows the enrolled phone completes readiness and a task round trip without reboot.

name: board-identity-prove-retired
stimulus: Firmware with the secure service: tools/list omits pdsh.identity.prove and a call returns UNSUPPORTED (14) with no receipt and no signature.

name: board-deterministic-ecdsa
stimulus: Sign the same digest twice with the device key through the TLS signing path; signatures are identical (RFC 6979).

name: board-entropy-before-secret-generation
stimulus: First boot after NVS erase: the device key, every eid and sc are generated only while the documented entropy source is active (logged).

name: physical-enroll-and-task-round-trip
stimulus: Offline enrollment with arm hold, indicator and confirm hold; one task accepted, executed and completed.

name: physical-reconnect
stimulus: Disconnect and reconnect; a new handshake and readiness, no stale state.

name: physical-board-reboot-recovery
stimulus: Reboot the board between accept and complete; the phone reconciles through status.

name: physical-phone-restart-recovery
stimulus: Kill the app after accept; on restart the task becomes unknown_outcome and is reported, never re-executed.

name: physical-long-task-across-session-renewal
stimulus: A task that runs for at least 4 minutes delivers its result across a session renewal without a new grant.

name: physical-unenrolled-phone
stimulus: A phone key not committed on the board.

name: physical-unenrolled-board
stimulus: A board not committed on the phone.

name: physical-changed-device-key
stimulus: Board after identity-reset.

name: physical-revoked-board
stimulus: Board record revoked.

name: physical-forgotten-phone
stimulus: Phone record forgotten.

name: physical-mac-peer-without-device-key
stimulus: Mac test peripheral exposing the secure service without the device key.

name: physical-two-enrolled-boards-swap
stimulus: Two enrolled boards; the user selects A while B answers the connection.

name: physical-short-press-never-arms
stimulus: Short presses with a staged host script never arm or commit; the press still opens the pairing window when unbonded.

name: physical-short-press-aborts-confirmation
stimulus: A short press after the press line aborts and leaves enrollment mode.

name: physical-indicator-visible-while-armed
stimulus: The indicator shows the armed pattern for the whole window and the confirm pattern while waiting for the hold.
